command:
set -eu
sudo -n true
printf 'user='; id
printf 'private_key='; sudo -n sh -c 'if [ -e /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key ]; then ls -l /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key; else echo absent; fi'

printf 'certificate='; if [ -e /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt ]; then ls -l /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt; else echo absent; fi

set -eu
umask 077
printf '%s\n' '[req]' 'distinguished_name = dn' 'prompt = no' 'x509_extensions = v3_ca' '[dn]' 'CN = OS Comparison Root CA' '[v3_ca]' 'subjectKeyIdentifier = hash' 'authorityKeyIdentifier = keyid:always,issuer' 'basicConstraints = critical, CA:true' 'keyUsage = critical, keyCertSign, cRLSign' > /tmp/os-comparison-root-ca.cnf
sudo -n install -d -m 0755 /usr/local/share/ca-certificates
sudo -n openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:4096 -nodes -sha256 -days 3650 -config /tmp/os-comparison-root-ca.cnf -keyout /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key -out /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
sudo -n chmod 0600 /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
sudo -n chmod 0644 /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
rm -f /tmp/os-comparison-root-ca.cnf
printf 'created\n'

command:
set -eu
CERT=/usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
KEY=/etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
sudo -n test -s "$KEY"
test -s "$CERT"
printf 'key_mode_owner='; sudo -n stat -c '%a %U:%G' "$KEY"
printf 'cert_mode_owner='; stat -c '%a %U:%G' "$CERT"
openssl x509 -in "$CERT" -noout -subject -issuer -serial -dates
openssl x509 -in "$CERT" -noout -text | sed -n '/X509v3 Basic Constraints/,+1p; /X509v3 Key Usage/,+1p'
printf 'system_trust_verify='; openssl verify -CApath /etc/ssl/certs "$CERT"
cert_mod=$(openssl x509 -in "$CERT" -noout -modulus | openssl sha256)
key_mod=$(sudo -n openssl rsa -in "$KEY" -noout -modulus 2>/dev/null | openssl sha256)
test "$cert_mod" = "$key_mod"
printf 'key_matches_certificate=yes\n'
